hook: Maryland now requires the 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights, a new housing disclosure, for every lease.

sections.voiceover: Maryland now requires the 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights, a new housing disclosure, for every lease.
On October 1, 2026, the Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development published the 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights. How can you ensure your rental contract remains compliant?
Maryland law mandates that landlords attach the official 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights without any modifications.
Landlords must attach the 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights to every lease agreement in Maryland.
The 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights is now mandatory statewide.
